description: This Java class `PdfService` provides functionalities to generate PDFs for client lists and contracts within a CRM application, utilizing iText (com.lowagie.text) library for PDF creation. It includes methods for printing client data tables and contract details, and interacts with a repository to fetch company information.

classes.name: PdfService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating PDF documents such as client lists and contracts, using the iText library, and interacting with the repository to fetch company data.

methods.name: printClientList
methods.description: Generates a PDF containing a list of clients with their details, saved to the specified filename.

methods.name: makeTablePdf
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a table populated with the provided data.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Generates a PDF document with the details of a contract, including client and company information.
